zh: 因为堵车，我要晚到一会儿。
en: I'm running late because of the traffic.
alt: The traffic's terrible, so I'll be a bit late.
point: “因为”后面是名词时用 because of，不是 because

zh: 虽然加班了，但是活儿干完了。
en: I had to stay late, but at least it's done.
alt: Even though I worked late, I got it finished.
point: “虽然…但是”英文只能选一个，不说 although … but

zh: 网太慢了，所以我关了摄像头。
en: The internet's really slow, so I've turned my camera off.
point: “因为…所以”二选一，这里只用 so

zh: 这台电脑虽然旧，还挺好用的。
en: This laptop's old, but it still works fine.
alt: Although this laptop's old, it still works fine.
point: “虽然…还”用 although 或 but 其一，再加 still

zh: 这家店很火，所以老要排队。
en: This place is really popular, so there's always a queue.
point: “火”是 popular；“要排队”说 there's a queue

zh: 甜点不要了，太饱了。
en: I'll skip dessert — I'm too full.
alt: I won't have dessert because I'm stuffed.
point: 中文不用连词，英文要用破折号或 because 连起来

zh: 我们输了，不过踢得不错。
en: We lost, but we played well.
alt: We lost, though we played pretty well.
point: “不过”就是 but，不用 although

zh: 今天膝盖疼，所以没去跑步。
en: My knee's sore, so I skipped my run today.
alt: I skipped my run because my knee hurts.
point: “疼”常说 sore；结果前用 so

zh: 太贵了，我就没买。
en: It was too expensive, so I didn't get it.
alt: I didn't buy it because it was too dear.
point: 中文“就”是结果，英文要补 so

zh: 既然打折，就多买几个吧。
en: Since it's on sale, let's get a few more.
alt: Seeing as it's on special, let's grab a few.
point: “既然”是 since，不是 already

zh: 我们坐火车去的，因为比开车便宜。
en: We took the train because it was cheaper than driving.
point: 原因放后面用 because，两边都用过去时

zh: 虽然很远，但是值得去。
en: It's a long way, but it's worth it.
alt: Even though it's far, it's worth the trip.
point: 不说 although … but；值得是 worth it，不说 worth to go

zh: 我感冒了，所以今天在家。
en: I've got a cold, so I'm staying home today.
point: “感冒了”是 I've got a cold，不是 I'm cold

zh: 难怪你这么累。
en: No wonder you're so tired.
alt: That's why you're so tired.
point: “难怪”是 no wonder，后面直接接句子

zh: 外面太吵了，我把窗户关了。
en: It was really noisy outside, so I shut the window.
point: 中文不用连词，英文要用 so 连接原因和结果

zh: 我家虽然小，但很温馨。
en: Our place is small but cosy.
alt: Our house is small, but it's really homely.
point: 一个 but 就够了；cosy 是英式拼写

zh: 我去不了，因为要加班。
en: I can't make it because I'm working late.
point: “去不了”是 can't make it；“加班”说 working late

zh: 我很想去，可是我明天一早要上班。
en: I'd love to, but I've got an early start tomorrow.
point: 婉拒先说 I'd love to, but；“一早上班”是 an early start

zh: 我没带现金，所以刷卡吧。
en: I've got no cash, so I'll pay by card.
alt: No cash on me, so I'll just tap my card.
point: “刷卡”是 pay by card / tap，不是 brush card

zh: 钱是挣得多，可是花得也多。
en: I earn good money, but I spend a lot too.
point: “A是A，可是…”只用 but，不必重复动词

zh: 因为下周放假，所以报告得这周五交。
en: Since next week's a holiday, the report needs to be in by this Friday.
alt: Next week's a public holiday, so the report's due this Friday.
point: 因为…所以只留一个；“交”是 be in / be due

zh: 他虽然是新来的，但对系统已经很熟了。
en: Even though he's new, he already knows the system inside out.
alt: He's new, but he already knows the system really well.
point: 用 even though 就不再加 but；很熟是 know … inside out

zh: 服务器昨晚宕机了，所以大家今天早上都登不上去。
en: The server went down last night — that's why nobody could log in this morning.
point: “所以才”可用 that's why，后面用陈述语序

zh: 驱动我更新了，打印机还是不能用。
en: I updated the driver, but the printer still won't work.
alt: Even though I've updated the driver, the printer still isn't working.
point: 中文没有“但是”，英文要加 but，“还是”用 still

zh: 这家的馥芮白太好喝了，我每天早上都来买。
en: The flat whites here are so good that I come in every morning.
alt: Their flat whites are amazing, so I'm in here every morning.
point: “太…所以”可用 so … that，so 放形容词前

zh: 菜虽然上得慢，但味道真的没话说。
en: The food took ages to come out, but it was absolutely delicious.
point: 只用 but；“上得慢”是 took ages to come out

zh: 既然雨停了，我们还能打一场高尔夫。
en: Now that the rain's stopped, we can still get a round of golf in.
alt: Since it's stopped raining, we've still got time for a round of golf.
point: “既然”除了 since，也常说 now that

zh: 他们队虽然少了一个人，最后还是赢了。
en: Even though they were a player down, they still managed to win.
point: 不说 although … but；“少一个人”是 a player down

zh: 我本来想买那双鞋，可是没有我的码了。
en: I was going to get those shoes, but they didn't have my size.
point: “本来想”是 was going to；“没码”是 didn't have my size

zh: 我是会员，所以在那家店买东西能打九折。
en: I'm a member, so I get ten percent off there.
alt: Because I'm a member, I get 10% off at that shop.
point: “打九折”是 ten percent off，不是 ninety percent

zh: 因为签证还没下来，我们只好推迟旅行。
en: Our visas haven't come through yet, so we've had to put the trip off.
point: 因为…所以只用 so；“签证下来”是 come through

zh: 尽管下着大雨，我们还是走完了汤加里罗步道。
en: We still did the Tongariro Crossing even though it was pouring.
alt: Even though it was bucketing down, we finished the Tongariro Crossing.
point: “尽管…还是”用 even though + still，不加 but

zh: 我最近在吃抗生素，所以不能喝酒。
en: I'm on antibiotics at the moment, so I can't drink.
point: “在吃药”是 be on antibiotics，不是 eating medicine

zh: 虽然医生说没什么大问题，我还是有点担心。
en: The doctor said it's nothing serious, but I'm still a bit worried.
alt: Even though the doctor says it's nothing major, I'm still a bit worried.
point: 只用 but + still，不要 although … but

zh: 开暖气太费电了，所以冬天我们在家都多穿几件。
en: Heating costs a fortune, so we just wear extra layers at home in winter.
point: “费电”是 costs a fortune；“多穿几件”是 wear layers

zh: 我们搬到这边是因为离孩子学校近。
en: We moved here because it's close to the kids' school.
point: “是因为”直接用 because，不说 is because

zh: 他平时挺安静的，不过喝两杯以后话就多了。
en: He's usually pretty quiet, though he opens up after a couple of drinks.
alt: He's normally quite quiet, but he gets chatty after a few drinks.
point: though 可放中间表转折；“话多了”是 opens up

zh: 既然你都请我吃饭了，下次咖啡我请。
en: Since you shouted dinner, coffee's on me next time.
alt: Seeing as you paid for dinner, next coffee's my shout.
point: “既然”用 since / seeing as；“我请”是 on me

zh: 最近汇率太差，所以这个月我先不往国内汇钱了。
en: The exchange rate's terrible right now, so I won't send any money home this month.
point: 因为…所以只用 so；“往国内汇钱”是 send money home

zh: 这个账户虽然利息高，但是取钱要提前通知。
en: This account pays good interest, but you have to give notice to withdraw.
alt: Although the interest rate's high on this account, you need to give notice before withdrawing.
point: 只用 but；“利息高”是 pays good interest

zh: 由于项目预算被砍了，我们不得不把上线时间推迟一个月。
en: Because the project budget's been cut, we've had to delay the go-live by a month.
alt: The budget's been slashed, so we've had no choice but to push go-live back a month.
point: “由于”用 because 就行；“不得不”是 have had to

zh: 这个方案前期投入是高一点，不过维护起来省事多了，长远来看是划算的。
en: This option costs a bit more upfront, but it's much easier to maintain, so it'll pay for itself in the long run.
point: “是…一点，不过”用 but；“长远来看”是 in the long run

zh: 我们之所以选 Azure，主要是因为客户那边已经在用微软全家桶了。
en: The main reason we went with Azure is that the client's already using the whole Microsoft stack.
alt: We chose Azure mainly because the client's already using Microsoft for pretty much everything.
point: “之所以…是因为”说 the reason … is that，不说 is because

zh: 测试环境都通过了，可一上生产还是出了问题，所以得好好查查配置哪里不一样。
en: Everything passed in test, but it still fell over in production, so we need to dig into what's different about the config.
point: “可…还是”用 but … still；“出问题”是 fell over

zh: 这家餐厅虽然贵了点，但服务和菜品都没得挑，所以周年纪念我们还是订了这里。
en: It's a bit on the pricey side, but the food and service are faultless, so we've booked it for our anniversary anyway.
point: “贵了点”是 on the pricey side；不要 although … but

zh: 他们说厨房人手不够，所以今晚只有套餐，不能单点。
en: They said they're short-staffed in the kitchen, so they're only doing a set menu tonight, nothing à la carte.
point: “人手不够”是 short-staffed；“只有套餐”用 only doing

zh: 上半场我们其实踢得挺好，可惜最后几分钟防守一松懈，被对方扳平了。
en: We actually played really well in the first half, but we switched off in the last few minutes and they equalised.
point: “可惜”不必直译，用 but 转折；“被扳平”说 they equalised

zh: 尽管黑蕨队赢了，很多球迷还是觉得她们远没发挥出真正的水平。
en: Even though the Black Ferns won, a lot of fans reckon they didn't play anywhere near their best.
point: even though 后不能再加 but；“觉得”Kiwi 常说 reckon

zh: 这件外套网上看着挺好，到手质量一般，退货还得自己出运费，算了。
en: The jacket looked great online, but the quality's pretty average in real life, and since I'd have to pay for return postage, it's not worth sending back.
point: 中文不用连词，英文要补 but / since 把转折和原因连起来

zh: New World 这周咖啡特价，所以我才大老远开车跑过来。
en: New World's got coffee on special this week — that's why I drove all the way across town.
point: “所以我才”用 that's why；“特价”是 on special

zh: 我们本来打算自己开车去雷因加角，可是路太烂了，最后还是报了个大巴团。
en: We'd planned to drive up to Cape Reinga ourselves, but the road was so rough that we ended up doing a bus tour instead.
point: “本来打算”是 we'd planned to；“最后”是 ended up

zh: 既然你们在惠灵顿只待一天，我建议先去 Te Papa，毕竟免费，下雨也不怕。
en: Since you've only got one day in Wellington, I'd start with Te Papa — it's free, after all, and it doesn't matter if it rains.
point: “既然”是 since；“毕竟”是 after all，常放句中或句尾

zh: 药我已经连着吃了一个星期了，咳嗽还是没好，所以想再来看看。
en: I've been taking the medication for a week now, but the cough still hasn't cleared up, so I thought I'd come back in.
point: 中文没有“但是”，英文要加 but；“没好”是 hasn't cleared up

zh: 医生说我背疼主要是因为久坐，所以让我每隔一小时起来活动一下。
en: The doctor says my back pain's mostly down to sitting all day, so she's told me to get up and move every hour.
point: “是因为”可说 be down to；“每隔一小时”是 every hour

zh: 那套房子我们最后没租，位置虽然好，但是太潮了，冬天肯定长霉。
en: We didn't take the flat in the end — the location was great, but it was really damp, so it'd definitely get mouldy in winter.
point: 因果和转折拆开，用 but 再用 so；mouldy 英式拼写

zh: 既然房东不肯修，那我们只能先自己垫钱找人修，之后再从房租里扣。
en: Since the landlord won't fix it, we'll just have to pay for it ourselves and take it off the rent later.
alt: Seeing as the landlord refuses to fix it, we'll cover it ourselves and deduct it from the rent.
point: “既然”是 since；“不肯”用 won't；“扣”是 take it off

zh: 他虽然在新西兰住了十年，但还是不太懂这边的幽默。
en: Even though he's lived in New Zealand for ten years, he still doesn't quite get Kiwi humour.
point: even though 不跟 but；“不太懂”是 doesn't quite get

zh: 那天聚会我没去，不是不想去，是女儿突然发烧了。
en: It's not that I didn't want to come to the party — it's just that my daughter suddenly came down with a temperature.
point: “不是…是…”用 It's not that … it's just that

zh: 既然我们每个月在外卖上花这么多钱，还不如自己做饭，一年能省好几千。
en: Seeing as we're spending so much on takeaways every month, we might as well cook at home — we'd save a few grand a year.
point: “既然”也可说 seeing as；“还不如”是 might as well

zh: KiwiSaver 最近虽然亏了一点，但这是长期投资，所以我不打算换基金。
en: My KiwiSaver's taken a bit of a hit lately, but since it's a long-term thing, I'm not going to switch funds.
point: 不用 although … but；“亏了”是 taken a hit

zh: 老板今天不在，所以会议取消了。
en: The boss is away today, so the meeting's off.
alt: The meeting's been cancelled because the boss is away today.
point: “取消了”口语可说 is off；原因在前就用 so

zh: 我手机没电了，所以没接到你电话。
en: My phone died, so I missed your call.
alt: Sorry, I missed your call because my phone went flat.
point: “没电了”是 died / went flat；“没接到”是 missed

zh: 汉堡有点贵，不过很好吃。
en: The burger was a bit pricey, but it was really good.
alt: The burger was a bit dear. Really good, though.
point: “不过”就是 but；也可把 though 放句尾

zh: 我游得不太好，但我很喜欢游泳。
en: I'm not a great swimmer, but I love it.
point: “游得不太好”说 not a great swimmer；转折只要 but

zh: 超市关门了，所以我去了街角的小店。
en: The supermarket was shut, so I went to the dairy.
point: 街角小卖部在新西兰叫 dairy；结果前用 so

zh: 航班延误了，我们等了三个小时。
en: The flight was delayed, so we waited three hours.
point: 中文不用连词，英文要补 so；两句都用过去时

zh: 我牙疼，所以约了牙医。
en: I've got toothache, so I've booked the dentist.
alt: My tooth's killing me, so I've made a dentist appointment.
point: “牙疼”是 toothache；“约医生”用 book

zh: 今晚太累了，不想做饭，点外卖吧。
en: I'm too tired to cook tonight, so let's get takeaways.
point: “太累了不想做”用 too tired to cook

zh: 他人挺好的，就是有点吵。
en: He's really nice, but he's a bit loud.
alt: He's lovely, just a bit loud.
point: “就是”表转折时用 but，不是 just is

zh: 我在攒钱，所以这周不出去吃了。
en: I'm saving up, so I'm not eating out this week.
point: “攒钱”是 saving up；“出去吃”是 eat out

zh: 我没被录用，因为没有本地经验。
en: I didn't get the job because I had no local experience.
point: “没被录用”说 didn't get the job；原因用 because

zh: 工资不高，但是离家近。
en: The pay isn't great, but it's close to home.
point: “工资”口语是 pay；只用 but，不加 although

zh: 既然你感兴趣，就去申请吧。
en: Since you're interested, go for it.
alt: If you're keen, why not apply?
point: “既然”是 since；“去试试吧”可说 go for it

zh: 我考试没过，因为没复习。
en: I failed the exam because I didn't revise.
alt: I didn't pass the exam because I didn't study for it.
point: “没过”直接用 failed；“复习”英式说 revise

zh: 这门课很难，不过老师人很好。
en: The course is hard, but the tutor's great.
point: 大学里的“老师”常说 tutor / lecturer；转折用 but

zh: 图书馆太吵了，我就回家学了。
en: The library was too noisy, so I studied at home.
point: “就”在这里表结果，英文用 so

zh: 房子很好，可是房租太高了。
en: The flat's lovely, but the rent's too high.
point: “可是”就是 but；租的房子常叫 flat

zh: 我们得搬家，因为房东要卖房子。
en: We had to move because the landlord was selling.
point: “要卖房”用进行时 was selling 表计划

zh: 离市区挺远的，不过我们还是租了。
en: It's far from town, but we took it anyway.
point: “还是租了”用 but … anyway；“租下”说 took it

zh: 隔壁在装修，所以特别吵。
en: Next door's renovating, so it's really noisy.
point: “隔壁”是 next door，可以直接当主语

zh: 我们不太熟，但他看起来人不错。
en: We don't know each other well, but he seems nice.
point: “不太熟”是 don't know each other well

zh: 我敲了门，可是没人在家。
en: I knocked, but nobody was home.
point: 中文“可是”就是 but；“没人在家”说 nobody was home

zh: 停电了，所以我们点了蜡烛。
en: There was a power cut, so we lit candles.
point: “停电”是 power cut，不是 stop electricity

zh: 我换了网络公司，因为原来的太慢了。
en: I switched broadband providers because my old one was too slow.
point: “换公司”是 switch providers；原因放后面用 because

zh: 天冷了，这个月电费特别高。
en: The power bill's huge this month because of the cold.
alt: It's been cold, so the power bill's huge this month.
point: “电费”是 power bill；名词 the cold 前用 because of

zh: 洗衣机坏了，所以我现在手洗。
en: The washing machine's broken, so I'm washing by hand.
point: “手洗”是 wash by hand；中文“所以”对应 so

zh: 水管工挺贵的，但是活儿干得好。
en: The plumber was expensive, but he did a good job.
point: “活儿干得好”是 did a good job

zh: 我自己修的，因为找不到人。
en: I fixed it myself because I couldn't find anyone.
point: “找不到人”是 couldn't find anyone

zh: 护照过期了，所以要办新的。
en: My passport's expired, so I need a new one.
point: “过期”是 expired；“办新的”说 a new one

zh: 排队的人很多，不过走得很快。
en: The queue was long, but it moved quickly.
point: “人很多”英文说 the queue was long；队伍“走得快”是 moved

zh: 表格被退回来了，因为我忘了签名。
en: The form came back because I forgot to sign it.
point: “被退回”说 came back；sign 后要加 it

zh: 我钱包丢了，所以报了警。
en: I lost my wallet, so I reported it to the police.
point: “报警”这里是 reported it to the police

zh: 伤得不重，但我们还是去了医院。
en: It wasn't serious, but we still went to hospital.
point: “还是”用 still；新西兰说 went to hospital 不加 the

zh: 地震了，大家都跑到外面去了。
en: There was an earthquake, so everyone ran outside.
point: 中文两句直接连，英文要用 so 连接因果

zh: 我的车没通过 WOF，因为轮胎太旧了。
en: My car failed its WOF because the tyres were worn.
point: “没通过”是 failed；tyres 是英式拼写

zh: 停车位很难找，所以我坐公交来的。
en: Parking's hard to find, so I came by bus.
point: “坐公交来”是 came by bus

zh: 油价涨了，不过我还得开车。
en: Petrol's gone up, but I still have to drive.
point: “油价涨了”是 petrol's gone up；“还得”用 still have to

zh: 天气不好，我们就没去海边。
en: The weather was bad, so we didn't go to the beach.
point: “就没去”的“就”表结果，用 so

zh: 既然天气这么好，我们去走走步道吧。
en: Since it's so nice out, let's go for a bush walk.
point: “既然”是 since；“走步道”NZ 常说 bush walk

zh: 虽然涂了防晒，我还是晒伤了。
en: Even though I wore sunscreen, I got burnt.
alt: I put sunscreen on, but I still got sunburnt.
point: even though 后面不再加 but

zh: 电影挺长的，但是不无聊。
en: The movie was long, but it wasn't boring.
point: “不无聊”直接说 wasn't boring

zh: 我喜欢看书，因为能放松。
en: I love reading because it helps me relax.
point: “能放松”说 helps me relax，主语是 it

zh: 我不玩游戏，太花时间了。
en: I don't play games because they eat up too much time.
point: 中文不用连词，英文要补 because；“花时间”是 eat up time

zh: 今天是她生日，所以我买了个蛋糕。
en: It's her birthday, so I got a cake.
point: “买”口语常用 get；因果用 so

zh: 虽然是圣诞节，他还是要上班。
en: It's Christmas, but he still has to work.
point: “虽然…还是”用 but … still，不说 although … but

zh: 婚礼在户外办的，可是下雨了。
en: The wedding was outdoors, but it rained.
point: “可是”就是 but；“在户外”是 outdoors

zh: 儿子病了，所以我今天请假。
en: My son's sick, so I'm taking the day off.
point: “请假”是 take the day off

zh: 我妈虽然七十了，身体很好。
en: Mum's seventy, but she's really fit.
alt: Even though Mum's seventy, she's very healthy.
point: 只用 but 就够；新西兰写 Mum 不写 Mom

zh: 她哭了，因为不想去幼儿园。
en: She cried because she didn't want to go to daycare.
alt: She was crying because she didn't want to go to kindy.
point: “幼儿园”NZ 说 daycare / kindy

zh: 狗一直叫，因为有人在门口。
en: The dog's barking because someone's at the door.
point: “有人在门口”说 someone's at the door

zh: 我们家猫很老了，但还挺活泼的。
en: Our cat's old, but she's still pretty lively.
point: 宠物常用 she / he 不用 it；“还”是 still

zh: 我们不能养狗，因为房东不让。
en: We can't have a dog because the landlord won't allow it.
point: “养狗”是 have a dog；“不让”是 won't allow it

zh: 我很紧张，因为明天要演讲。
en: I'm nervous because I've got a speech tomorrow.
point: “要演讲”说 I've got a speech

zh: 对不起我忘了，最近太忙了。
en: Sorry I forgot, I've been flat out.
alt: Sorry, I forgot because I've been so busy.
point: 中文不用“因为”，英文口语也可直接接原因；“太忙”是 flat out

zh: 我有点难过，不过没事。
en: I'm a bit down, but I'm OK.
point: “难过”常说 down；“没事”是 I'm OK

zh: 今年我们组谁都没涨工资，因为公司亏损了。
en: Nobody in our team got a pay rise this year because the company made a loss.
point: “亏损”是 made a loss；“涨工资”是 pay rise

zh: 新软件太难用了，我们最后又换回了旧的。
en: The new software was so clunky that we ended up switching back.
alt: The new software was really clunky, so we went back to the old one in the end.
point: “太…结果”可用 so … that；“难用”是 clunky

zh: 还好我们提前订了位，不然肯定没座。
en: Good thing we booked ahead, otherwise we'd never have got a table.
point: “不然”是 otherwise，后面接 would have done

zh: 健身房离公司很近，所以我午休的时候去。
en: The gym's close to work, so I go in my lunch break.
point: “午休时”是 in my lunch break；“公司”这里说 work

zh: 这台吸尘器虽然打折了，还是比别的店贵。
en: Even though the vacuum's on sale, it's still dearer than at the other shops.
point: even though + still，不加 but；“贵”口语说 dear

zh: 酒店就在市中心，所以去哪儿都很方便。
en: The hotel's right in the city centre, so it's easy to get around.
point: “去哪儿都方便”说 easy to get around；centre 英式拼写

zh: 我最近睡得不好，可能是咖啡喝多了。
en: I haven't been sleeping well, probably because I drink too much coffee.
point: “可能是因为”用 probably because，放在后半句

zh: 我们把草坪改成了菜地，反正也没人在上面玩。
en: We've turned the lawn into a veggie patch since nobody uses it anyway.
point: 此处 since = because；“反正”是 anyway，放句尾

zh: 好多年没见了，不过她一点都没变。
en: I hadn't seen her for years, but she hasn't changed a bit.
point: “一点没变”是 hasn't changed a bit；“不过”= but

zh: 我把信用卡注销了，因为老是忍不住乱花钱。
en: I cancelled my credit card because I kept overspending.
point: “老是忍不住”用 kept + -ing；“乱花钱”是 overspend

zh: 面试挺顺利的，但到现在还没消息。
en: The interview went well, but I still haven't heard back.
point: “没消息”是 haven't heard back；“还”是 still

zh: 我辞职了，因为每天通勤要花两个小时。
en: I quit my job because I was spending two hours a day commuting.
point: “花时间做某事”是 spend … + -ing

zh: 既然已经拿到 offer 了，我就不再投别的了。
en: Now that I've got an offer, I'm going to stop applying elsewhere.
point: “既然已经”用 now that，强调情况已经变了

zh: 我报了夜校，因为白天要上班。
en: I've enrolled in night classes because I work during the day.
point: “报名”是 enrol；“夜校”是 night classes

zh: 论文写完了，就是晚交了两天。
en: I finished the essay, though it was two days late.
alt: I got the essay done, but it was two days late.
point: though 放后半句补充转折，不需要 but

zh: 我雅思口语只考了 6 分，所以得再考一次。
en: I only got a 6 in IELTS speaking, so I'll have to resit it.
point: “再考一次”是 resit；“考了6分”是 got a 6

zh: 看房的人太多了，我们根本没机会。
en: There were so many people at the viewing that we didn't stand a chance.
point: “太多…以至于”用 so many … that；“没机会”是 didn't stand a chance

zh: 押金退回来了，不过扣了一笔清洁费。
en: We got our bond back, but they took out a cleaning fee.
point: “押金”是 bond；“扣了”是 took out

zh: 我跟三个人合租，所以房租不算贵。
en: I share a flat with three others, so the rent's not bad.
point: “合租”是 share a flat；“不算贵”口语说 not bad

zh: 邻居家的树把阳光挡住了，所以我的菜长不好。
en: The neighbour's tree blocks the sun, so my veggies won't grow properly.
point: “挡住”是 blocks；“长不好”是 won't grow properly

zh: 他们家的狗叫了半夜，害得我一宿没睡。
en: Their dog was barking half the night, so I didn't get any sleep.
point: “害得我”不必直译，用 so 表结果就行

zh: 我们只是邻居，可她帮了我太多了。
en: We're only neighbours, but she's done so much for me.
point: “帮了我很多”说 done so much for me；只用 but

zh: 网断了一整天，我只好去图书馆办公。
en: The internet was down all day, so I had to work from the library.
point: “断网”是 the internet was down；“只好”是 had to

zh: 虽然换了套餐，话费一点都没少。
en: Even though I changed plans, my phone bill hasn't gone down at all.
point: “话费没少”是 bill hasn't gone down；even though 不配 but

zh: 因为管道检修，明天上午停水。
en: The water will be off tomorrow morning due to maintenance.
point: 通知里“因为”+ 名词常用 due to；“停水”是 water will be off

zh: 屋顶漏水了，所以得赶紧找人来修。
en: The roof's leaking, so we need to get someone in quickly.
point: “找人来修”是 get someone in

zh: 零件得从澳大利亚订，所以要等两个星期。
en: The part has to come from Australia, so it'll take two weeks.
point: “要等两周”说 it'll take two weeks

zh: 架子是我自己装的，有点歪，不过挺结实。
en: I put the shelf up myself — it's a bit crooked, but it's solid.
point: “歪”是 crooked；“装架子”是 put up a shelf

zh: 我搬家了，所以得更新驾照上的地址。
en: I've moved, so I need to update the address on my licence.
point: “地址变了”直接说 I've moved；licence 英式拼写

zh: 网上预约都满了，我只好打电话。
en: There were no slots left online, so I had to ring them.
point: “只好”是 had to；“打电话”NZ 常说 ring

zh: 邮局关门挺早的，不过周六上午也开。
en: The post shop shuts early, though it's open on Saturday mornings.
point: though 放句中相当于 but；“关门”可用 shuts

zh: 路面结冰，好几辆车撞到了一起。
en: Several cars crashed into each other because the road was icy.
point: 中文不用“因为”，英文要补 because；“结冰”是 icy

zh: 我闻到一股煤气味，就马上打了 111。
en: I smelt gas, so I rang 111 straight away.
point: “闻到”是 smelt；“马上”是 straight away

zh: 只是个小火，消防却来了三辆车。
en: It was only a small fire, but three fire engines still turned up.
point: “却”不用译成 although，用 but … still

zh: 公交又晚点了，我干脆走路去上班了。
en: The bus was late again, so I just walked to work instead.
point: “干脆”常用 just … instead

zh: 我的车 rego 过期了，因为忘了续。
en: My rego's expired because I forgot to renew it.
point: “续”是 renew；“车辆注册”NZ 叫 rego

zh: 这条路虽然远一点，但不堵车。
en: This way's a bit longer, but there's no traffic.
point: “不堵车”说 there's no traffic；只用 but

zh: 预报说有暴风雨，所以我们把露营取消了。
en: The forecast said there'd be a storm, so we called off the camping trip.
point: “取消”是 call off；转述预报用 there'd be

zh: 这条步道很陡，不过风景特别美。
en: The track's steep, but the views are stunning.
point: “步道”是 track；“风景”常说 the views

zh: 天这么冷，他居然穿着人字拖。
en: It's freezing, and yet he's wearing jandals.
alt: It's freezing, but he's still wearing jandals.
point: “居然”表意外的转折可用 and yet；人字拖 NZ 叫 jandals

zh: 我常去的理发师辞职了，所以只好找个新的。
en: My hairdresser's left, so I've had to find a new one.
point: “辞职”这里说 left；“只好”用 have had to

zh: 这本书开头有点慢，不过后面越来越好看。
en: The book starts slowly, but it gets really good later on.
point: “后面越来越好看”是 gets really good later on

zh: 那场演出我们没去成，因为保姆临时来不了。
en: We missed the gig because our babysitter cancelled at the last minute.
point: “临时”是 at the last minute；小型演出口语叫 gig

zh: 既然大家都放假，圣诞就一起过吧。
en: Seeing as everyone's off work, let's do Christmas together.
point: “既然”也可说 seeing as；“放假”是 off work

zh: 葬礼上大家虽然很难过，还是讲了很多他的趣事。
en: It was a sad funeral, though everyone shared funny stories about him.
point: though 在句中连接，不要 although … but

zh: 我们没送花，因为她对花粉过敏。
en: We didn't bring flowers because she's allergic to pollen.
point: “对…过敏”是 allergic to

zh: 我爸妈要来住半年，所以我们换了个大点的房子。
en: My parents are coming to stay for six months, so we've moved somewhere bigger.
point: “换了大点的房子”说 moved somewhere bigger

zh: 她虽然才五岁，已经会说两种语言了。
en: Even though she's only five, she can already speak two languages.
point: only … already 搭配，even though 后不加 but

zh: 家里是我老公做饭，因为我下班比较晚。
en: My husband does the cooking since I finish work later.
point: 这里 since = because；“做饭”是 does the cooking

zh: 我们要出门几天，所以把狗送去寄养了。
en: We're going away, so we've put the dog in kennels.
point: “寄养狗”是 put … in kennels

zh: 兽医说它太胖了，所以得少喂点。
en: The vet says she's overweight, so we need to cut back her food.
point: “少喂点”是 cut back her food

zh: 这只猫是我们捡来的，现在成了全家的宝贝。
en: We found the cat as a stray, but now she's the whole family's favourite.
point: 中文没有转折词，英文用 but 突出前后反差

zh: 我知道他是好意，可我还是有点不舒服。
en: I know he meant well, but it still upset me a bit.
point: “是好意”是 meant well；“不舒服”这里是 upset

zh: 她一直没回我消息，所以我有点担心。
en: She hasn't replied to my messages, so I'm a bit worried.
point: “一直没回”用现在完成 hasn't replied

zh: 吵完那一架，我们反而更亲近了。
en: We had a big fight, but we're actually closer now because of it.
point: “反而”用 but … actually；because of it 点明原因

zh: 虽然大家都不同意，经理还是坚持要改流程。
en: Even though nobody agreed, the manager still insisted on changing the process.
point: “坚持要”是 insist on + -ing；even though 不再加 but

zh: 老板今天心情特别好，因为我们拿下了那个大客户。
en: The boss is in a great mood today because we've landed that big client.
point: “拿下客户”是 land a client；“心情好”是 in a good mood

zh: 会议改到了下午，这样悉尼的同事也能参加。
en: We've moved the meeting to the afternoon so that the Sydney team can join.
point: “这样…能”表目的要用 so that，和表结果的 so 不同

zh: 我把所有密码都改了，因为邮箱被黑了。
en: I've changed all my passwords because my email account got hacked.
point: “被黑了”是 got hacked；原因从句用过去时

zh: 尽管装了杀毒软件，我的电脑还是中了病毒。
en: Despite having antivirus installed, I still got a virus on my laptop.
alt: Even though I had antivirus on it, my laptop still got a virus.
point: despite 后接名词或 -ing，不能接完整句子

zh: 这手机电池不太行，不过考虑到价格，已经很不错了。
en: The battery's not great, but considering the price, it's a pretty good phone.
point: “考虑到”是 considering，后面直接接名词

zh: 那份工作我没拿到，不过只是因为他们要新西兰公民。
en: I missed out on the job, but only because they needed a New Zealand citizen.
point: “只是因为”可用 but only because；“没拿到”是 missed out on

zh: 这家公司工资一般，但福利特别好，所以我还挺心动的。
en: The salary's average, but the benefits are really good, so I'm quite tempted.
point: “心动”是 tempted；but 和 so 分别连三个分句

zh: 既然他们已经联系了我的推荐人，offer 应该快下来了。
en: Now that they've called my referees, the offer should be on its way.
point: “推荐人”是 referees；now that 表已发生的新情况

zh: 我选了网课，因为可以按自己的节奏学。
en: I chose the online course because I can study at my own pace.
point: “按自己的节奏”是 at my own pace

zh: 这门课作业虽然多，却是我这学期最喜欢的。
en: Even though there's a lot of coursework, it's my favourite paper this semester.
point: 新西兰大学的“一门课”叫 paper；“却”不用译

zh: 我英语进步很快，主要是因为天天跟同事聊天。
en: My English has improved a lot, mainly because I chat with my colleagues every day.
point: “主要是因为”是 mainly because，放在句中

zh: 我们开始堆肥了，扔的垃圾一下子少了很多。
en: We've started composting, so we're throwing out way less rubbish.
point: 中文不用“所以”，英文要补 so；“垃圾”是 rubbish

zh: 烘干机方便是方便，就是太费电，所以我们还是晾在外面。
en: The dryer's handy, but it uses heaps of power, so we still hang things outside.
point: “A是A，就是…”用 but；“晾衣服”是 hang things outside

zh: 他做饭很好吃，就是每次都把厨房弄得一团糟。
en: He's a great cook, though he always leaves the kitchen in a complete mess.
point: “就是”表轻微转折可用 though；“弄得一团糟”是 leave … in a mess

zh: 因为地毯上有污渍，他们扣了我们一半的押金。
en: They kept half our bond because of the stains on the carpet.
point: 名词 the stains 前用 because of；“扣押金”说 kept the bond

zh: 房租虽然涨了，我们还是续了约，因为搬家实在太麻烦。
en: The rent's gone up, but we're renewing the lease anyway because moving's such a hassle.
point: “续约”是 renew the lease；“麻烦”是 hassle

zh: 物业经理一直不回邮件，所以我直接打了电话。
en: The property manager kept ignoring my emails, so I just rang her directly.
point: “一直不回”可说 kept ignoring；“直接”是 directly

zh: 他们家的车老停在我们车道口，我只好去跟他们谈了谈。
en: They kept parking across our driveway, so I had to have a word with them.
point: “谈一谈”是 have a word with；“车道口”是 across our driveway

zh: 老王家的猫丢了，难怪他这两天一直在街上转悠。
en: Mr Wang's cat has gone missing — that's why he's been wandering up and down the street.
point: “难怪”除了 no wonder，也可用 that's why

zh: 虽然搬来才一个月，我已经认识这条街一半的人了。
en: Even though we only moved in a month ago, I already know half the street.
point: even though + only … already，不加 but

zh: 我们换了家电力公司，因为原来那家一年涨了两次价。
en: We switched power companies because our old one put the prices up twice in a year.
point: “涨价”是 put the prices up

zh: 暴风雨把电线刮断了，我们整条街停了一晚上电。
en: The storm brought the lines down, so our whole street lost power overnight.
point: “停电”也可说 lost power；“刮断”是 brought down

zh: 套餐说是无限流量，可一到晚上网速就慢得不行。
en: The plan's meant to be unlimited, but the speed drops right off in the evenings.
point: “说是”用 meant to be；转折用 but

zh: 热水器坏了，所以我们洗了三天冷水澡。
en: The hot water cylinder's packed up, so we've had cold showers for three days.
point: “坏了”Kiwi 常说 packed up；热水器是 hot water cylinder

zh: 我们找了三家报价，因为第一家报得太离谱了。
en: We got three quotes because the first one was ridiculously high.
point: “报价”是 quote；“离谱”是 ridiculously high

zh: 电工说线路太老了，与其修还不如全部换掉。
en: The electrician said the wiring's so old that it's better to replace it all.
point: “太…所以”用 so … that；“不如”是 better to

zh: 网上订的沙发到现在还没送来，所以我申请退款了。
en: The couch I ordered online still hasn't turned up, so I've asked for a refund.
point: “还没送来”是 still hasn't turned up

zh: 那家店东西是贵一点，不过退换货特别方便。
en: Their stuff's a bit dearer, but returns are really easy there.
point: “是…一点，不过”用 but；“退换货”是 returns

zh: 既然这周积分翻倍，我干脆把一个月的东西都买齐。
en: Since it's double points this week, I might as well do the whole month's shopping.
point: “干脆”可用 might as well

zh: 那家要等四十分钟，所以我们换了一家吃。
en: We went somewhere else because there was a forty-minute wait.
point: “要等四十分钟”是 a forty-minute wait，形容词带连字符

zh: 她吃素，所以我们挑了一家素菜多的餐厅。
en: She's vegetarian, so we picked a place with plenty of veggie options.
point: “素菜多”是 plenty of veggie options

zh: 他们家的外卖好吃是好吃，就是每次都送得特别慢。
en: Their takeaways are delicious, but the delivery's always painfully slow.
point: “好吃是好吃，就是”只用 but；“送得慢”是 delivery's slow

zh: 我把自动扣款取消了，因为同一笔钱被扣了两次。
en: I've cancelled the direct debit because they took the same payment twice.
point: “自动扣款”是 direct debit；“被扣”主动说 they took

zh: 那条短信看着像银行发的，其实是诈骗。
en: The text looked like it was from the bank, but it was actually a scam.
point: “其实”的转折用 but … actually

zh: 虽然利率降了一点，我们还是决定先固定一年。
en: Even though interest rates have dropped a bit, we've decided to fix for a year.
point: “固定利率”是 fix；even though 后不加 but

zh: 我的申请被退回来了，因为照片不符合要求。
en: My application was sent back because the photo didn't meet the requirements.
point: “不符合要求”是 didn't meet the requirements

zh: 既然网上能续，就没必要专门跑一趟了。
en: Since you can renew it online, there's no need to go in person.
point: “专门跑一趟”是 go in person

zh: 我在市政网站上提交了投诉，可到现在还没人回复。
en: I lodged a complaint on the council website, but nobody's got back to me yet.
point: “提交投诉”是 lodge a complaint；“回复”是 get back to

zh: 周末家庭医生不开门，所以我去了急诊诊所。
en: My GP's closed on weekends, so I went to an after-hours clinic.
point: “急诊诊所”NZ 常说 after-hours (clinic)

zh: 药虽然难吃，不过吃了以后好多了。
en: The medicine tastes awful, but I feel heaps better since taking it.
point: 此处 since 是“自从”，不是“因为”

zh: 牙医说我牙龈出血是因为刷牙太用力了。
en: The dentist reckons my gums are bleeding because I brush too hard.
point: “…是因为…”中的“是”不译，直接 because；“牙龈”是 gums

zh: 我们听到了海啸警报，就马上往高处跑。
en: We heard the tsunami warning, so we headed straight for higher ground.
point: “往高处跑”是 head for higher ground

zh: 我们的车被偷了，还好里面没放什么值钱的东西。
en: Our car got stolen, but luckily there was nothing valuable inside.
point: “还好”是 luckily，和 but 搭配

zh: 他伤得不重，可急救人员还是坚持送他去医院检查。
en: Even though he wasn't badly hurt, the paramedics insisted on taking him in to be checked.
point: “还是坚持”用 insisted on；even though 不配 but

zh: 我们打算把第二辆车卖了，因为保险和 rego 太贵了。
en: We're selling our second car because the insurance and rego cost too much.
point: 现在进行时表已定的计划；原因用 because

zh: 我开得比限速慢一点，因为路上全是坑。
en: I'm driving a bit under the limit because the road's full of potholes.
point: “限速”是 the limit；“坑”是 potholes

zh: 我们没坐轮渡，而是开车绕远路，因为带着狗。
en: We drove the long way round instead of taking the ferry, since we had the dog with us.
point: “没…而是”用 instead of；since 表原因

zh: 我们的行李在转机时丢了，所以第一天只能穿同一套衣服。
en: Our luggage got lost on the transfer, so we had to wear the same clothes on day one.
point: “转机”是 transfer / connection；“只能”是 had to

zh: 虽然是淡季，酒店还是全满了，因为城里在开大会。
en: Even though it's off-season, the hotels are all full because of a big conference in town.
point: “淡季”是 off-season；两个连词各管一层关系

zh: 幸好买了旅行保险，结果还真用上了。
en: We got travel insurance, which was just as well because we ended up needing it.
point: “幸好”可用 just as well；“结果”是 ended up

zh: 那条步道因为塌方暂时关闭了。
en: The track's closed for now because of a slip.
point: “塌方”NZ 说 slip；名词前用 because of

zh: 我们早上五点就出发了，好在下午变天前下山。
en: We set off at five so we'd be off the mountain before the weather turned.
point: “好…”表目的用 so (that) we'd，不是表结果

zh: 虽然是夏天，山上晚上还是冷得要命。
en: Even in summer, it gets freezing up in the hills at night.
point: “虽然是夏天”可简化成 even in summer

zh: 他受伤了，这赛季剩下的比赛都打不了了。
en: He's injured, so he'll miss the rest of the season.
point: “打不了比赛”说 miss the rest of the season

zh: 虽然我们队排名垫底，每场比赛看台还是坐得满满的。
en: Even though we're bottom of the table, the stands are still packed every game.
point: “垫底”是 bottom of the table；“满”是 packed

zh: 既然你每周都去，办年卡比按次付钱划算多了。
en: Since you go every week, an annual membership works out much cheaper than paying per visit.
point: “划算”是 works out cheaper；“既然”用 since

zh: 那部剧评价很高，可我看了两集就放弃了。
en: That show's had great reviews, but I gave up after two episodes.
point: “放弃”是 gave up；“评价高”是 great reviews

zh: 我加入了一个读书会，主要是想多认识点人。
en: I joined a book club, mainly because I wanted to meet new people.
point: “主要是想”用 mainly because I wanted to

zh: 因为下雨，音乐节改到室内了。
en: The festival's been moved indoors due to the rain.
point: “因为”+ 名词可用 due to；“改到室内”是 moved indoors

zh: 我本来想早点走，可大家聊得太开心了，一直待到半夜。
en: I meant to leave early, but we were having such a good time that I stayed till midnight.
point: “太…以至于”在名词前用 such a … that

zh: 他说话很直，有些人觉得他没礼貌，其实他人很好。
en: He's quite blunt, so some people think he's rude, but he's actually lovely.
point: “直”是 blunt；“其实”用 but … actually

zh: 既然大家都在附近，干脆一起吃个午饭吧。
en: Seeing as we're all in the area, we might as well grab lunch together.
point: “都在附近”是 in the area；seeing as 比 since 更口语

zh: 今年中秋我们没回国，所以在这边跟朋友一起过的。
en: We didn't go back to China for the Mid-Autumn Festival this year, so we celebrated with friends here.
point: “过节”是 celebrate；“回国”是 go back to China

zh: 虽然说好了不送礼物，她还是给每个人都准备了一份。
en: Even though we'd agreed on no presents, she still got everyone something.
point: “说好了”是 had agreed；“准备了一份”说 got everyone something

zh: 婚礼请柬上写着不带孩子，所以我们得找人看孩子。
en: The invitation said no kids, so we've had to sort out a babysitter.
point: “找人看孩子”是 sort out a babysitter

zh: 女儿哭着回的家，因为在学校被同学取笑了。
en: My daughter came home in tears because the other kids had been teasing her.
point: “哭着回家”是 came home in tears；“取笑”是 tease

zh: 我婆婆不会说英语，却跟邻居聊得很开心。
en: My mother-in-law doesn't speak English, yet she gets on brilliantly with the neighbours.
point: “却”可用 yet；“处得好”是 get on

zh: 现在孩子大了，我打算回去全职上班。
en: Now that the kids are older, I'm planning to go back to work full-time.
point: “现在…了”表情况变化用 now that

zh: 我们给狗买了宠物保险，因为去年看兽医花了好几千。
en: We've got pet insurance now because the vet bills last year came to a few thousand.
point: “花了好几千”说 came to a few thousand

zh: 这只狗看起来挺凶，其实特别温顺。
en: He looks a bit scary, but he's actually a big softie.
point: “温顺的家伙”可说 a softie；“其实”用 but … actually

zh: 我们晚上把猫关在家里，因为它老抓附近的鸟。
en: We keep the cat in at night because she keeps catching the native birds.
point: “关在家里”是 keep … in；“老…”是 keeps + -ing

zh: 我道歉不是因为我错了，而是不想再吵下去了。
en: I apologised, not because I was wrong, but because I didn't want to keep arguing.
point: “不是因为…而是因为”说 not because … but because

zh: 我知道你只是想帮忙，但这件事我想自己决定。
en: I know you're only trying to help, but I need to decide this for myself.
point: “为我好/想帮忙”是 only trying to help

zh: 虽然来了好几年了，有时候还是会特别想家。
en: Even though I've been here for years, I still get really homesick sometimes.
point: “想家”是 homesick；even though + still

zh: 这周我手上的活儿太多了，周五的培训恐怕去不了，不过下次一定参加。
en: I've got too much on my plate this week, so I don't think I'll make Friday's training, but I'll definitely come to the next one.
point: “手上事多”是 too much on my plate；so 和 but 各连一层

zh: 我们本来想自己搭服务器，但考虑到维护成本，最后还是选了云服务。
en: We'd thought about hosting it ourselves, but given the maintenance overhead, we went with a cloud service in the end.
point: “考虑到”可用 given + 名词；“最后”是 in the end

zh: 订位的时候我们说了有人对坚果过敏，可菜上来还是撒了花生，只好退回去。
en: We mentioned the nut allergy when we booked, but the dish still came out with peanuts on it, so we had to send it back.
point: “退菜”是 send it back；“可…还是”用 but … still

zh: 我都三年没打板球了，周末还是被拉去当替补，结果打得还不错。
en: I hadn't played cricket for three years, but I got roped in as a sub at the weekend, and I didn't do too badly.
point: “被拉去”是 got roped in；“还不错”是 didn't do too badly

zh: 我想退这个烤面包机，因为才用了两天就不热了，小票我还留着。
en: I'd like to return this toaster because it stopped heating up after two days — I've still got the receipt.
point: “才用了两天就”说 after two days；“小票”是 receipt

zh: 航空公司超售了，我们被改到了第二天的航班，好在他们给安排了酒店。
en: The airline overbooked the flight, so we got bumped to the next day, but at least they put us up in a hotel.
point: “被挤下航班”是 got bumped；“安排住宿”是 put us up

zh: 我最近老是头疼，不知道是不是因为看屏幕时间太长了。
en: I've been getting a lot of headaches lately, and I'm wondering whether it's because of too much screen time.
point: “不知道是不是因为”用 I'm wondering whether it's because of

zh: 洗碗机我们基本不用，因为手洗反而更快，还省水。
en: We hardly ever use the dishwasher, because washing up by hand is actually quicker, and it saves water too.
point: “反而更快”用 actually quicker；“基本不用”是 hardly ever use

zh: 说实话我不太喜欢大型聚会，倒不是怕生，就是人一多我就觉得累。
en: To be honest, I'm not big on large parties. I'm not shy; it's more that big crowds wear me out.
point: “倒不是…就是”可用 it's more that；“累”是 wear me out

zh: 这个月我们把订阅全停了，因为一算才发现，每个月在这上面花了快两百块。
en: We've cancelled all our subscriptions this month, because when we added it up, we were spending nearly two hundred a month on them.
point: “一算才发现”是 when we added it up

zh: 非常感谢你们给的 offer，不过考虑之后，我决定去另一家，主要是离家近很多。
en: Thanks so much for the offer, but after some thought I've decided to accept another role, mainly because it's much closer to home.
point: 婉拒用 but after some thought；原因用 mainly because

zh: 我离开上一家公司是因为公司重组，整个团队都被裁了，跟工作本身没关系。
en: I left my last job because of a restructure — the whole team was made redundant, so it had nothing to do with the work itself.
point: “被裁”是 made redundant；“重组”是 restructure

zh: 我在新西兰的工作经验不多，但在国内带过十个人的团队，所以管理上没问题。
en: I haven't got much New Zealand experience, but I managed a team of ten back home, so I'm comfortable with leadership.
point: “国内”是 back home；用 but + so，不要 although … but

zh: 这学期我只选了两门课，因为还要上班，不然肯定忙不过来。
en: I've only taken two papers this semester because I'm juggling work as well — otherwise I'd never keep up.
point: “兼顾”是 juggle；“不然”是 otherwise

zh: 我申请了论文延期，因为上周家里有急事，医生证明也附上了。
en: I've asked for an extension on my essay because of a family emergency last week, and I've attached a medical certificate.
point: “延期”是 an extension；名词短语前用 because of

zh: 雅思我考了两次，第二次分数高了不少，主要是因为练了很多口语。
en: I sat IELTS twice, and my score went up quite a bit the second time, mostly because I'd done heaps of speaking practice.
point: “考试”用 sat；原因里用过去完成 I'd done

zh: 我们想提前退租，因为买了房子，请问需要提前多久通知？
en: We'd like to end the tenancy early because we've bought a house — how much notice do we need to give?
point: “退租”是 end the tenancy；“提前通知”是 give notice

zh: 看房的时候觉得挺好，住进来才发现窗户全都漏风，冬天根本暖和不起来。
en: The place looked great at the viewing, but once we moved in we realised the windows were all draughty, so it never warms up in winter.
point: “漏风”是 draughty；“住进来才发现”是 once we moved in

zh: 既然你下个月就搬走了，我们得赶紧发帖找新室友。
en: Since you're moving out next month, we'd better get an ad up for a new flatmate pretty quickly.
point: “发帖”是 get an ad up；“室友”是 flatmate

zh: 不好意思打扰一下，你们家狗白天一直叫，可能是你们上班时它太孤单了。
en: Sorry to bother you, but your dog's been barking a lot during the day — I think it's because he's lonely while you're at work.
point: 开口先用 Sorry to bother you, but；推测原因用 I think it's because

zh: 社区群里有人说最近老丢信，所以大家最好装个带锁的信箱。
en: Someone in our community group said mail's been going missing, so it might be worth getting a lockable letterbox.
point: “最好”委婉说 it might be worth；“丢信”是 mail going missing

zh: 隔壁的派对闹得挺晚，不过他们提前打过招呼，所以我也就没说什么。
en: Next door's party went pretty late, but they'd warned us beforehand, so I didn't make a fuss.
point: “打招呼”这里是 warned us；“没说什么”是 didn't make a fuss

zh: 你好，我们这个月的电费是平时的两倍，可我们用电习惯没变，能帮忙查一下吗？
en: Hi, our power bill's twice what it normally is this month, but we haven't changed how we use power — could you look into it?
point: “是平时的两倍”是 twice what it normally is；“查一下”是 look into

zh: 光纤还没铺到我们这条街，所以暂时只能用无线宽带。
en: Fibre hasn't reached our street yet, so we're stuck with wireless broadband for the time being.
point: “暂时只能”是 stuck with … for the time being

zh: 既然是你们那边的问题，那断网这几天的费用应该给我们退一些吧。
en: Since the outage was on your end, I think we should get some credit for the days we were without internet.
point: “你们那边的问题”是 on your end；“退费”可说 credit

zh: 师傅说今天来不了，因为零件还没到，所以改到周四了。
en: The tradie can't make it today because the part hasn't arrived, so he's moved us to Thursday.
point: “师傅”NZ 叫 tradie；because 和 so 各管一层

zh: 他们的报价比另外两家高，可他们是唯一能保证下周开工的。
en: Their quote's higher than the other two, but they're the only ones who can guarantee starting next week.
point: “保证开工”是 guarantee starting；转折用 but

zh: 我本来想自己换水龙头，结果越弄越漏，最后还是得叫水管工。
en: I tried to replace the tap myself, but I only made the leak worse, so I've had to call a plumber in the end.
point: “越弄越漏”是 only made the leak worse

zh: 我打电话是想问问签证申请的进度，因为已经比预计时间晚了两个星期。
en: I'm calling to check on my visa application, because it's now two weeks past the expected processing time.
point: “查进度”是 check on；“超过”是 past

zh: 表格我早就寄出去了，可因为地址写错了，又被退了回来。
en: I'd already posted the form, but it came back to me because I'd got the address wrong.
point: “写错了”是 got … wrong；先发生的用过去完成

zh: 网上说可以直接去办，到了那儿才知道必须预约。
en: The website said we could just walk in, but when we got there it turned out you need an appointment.
point: “到那儿才知道”是 it turned out

zh: 我们刚报了警，因为回家发现后门被撬了，还不知道少了什么东西。
en: We've just rung the police because we came home to find the back door forced open, and we're not sure what's missing yet.
point: “回家发现”是 came home to find；“被撬”是 forced open

zh: 那场风暴之后，我们这片停了三天电，幸好邻居家有发电机。
en: After the storm we were without power for three days, but luckily our neighbours had a generator.
point: “停了三天电”说 without power for three days；“幸好”用 but luckily

zh: 他摔倒的时候撞到了头，虽然现在看着没事，我们还是叫了救护车。
en: He hit his head when he fell, so even though he seems fine now, we've called an ambulance to be safe.
point: so 和 even though 可以连用，但不能再加 but

zh: 早上火车取消了，我只好打车去上班，花了快六十块。
en: My train was cancelled this morning, so I had to get an Uber to work, which cost nearly sixty bucks.
point: which 引出补充的结果；“打车”说 get an Uber / a taxi

zh: 那条路限速一百，不过弯道太多，我一般开八十左右。
en: The limit's a hundred on that road, but it's so windy that I usually sit on about eighty.
point: “弯多”是 windy；“开八十左右”是 sit on about eighty

zh: 既然你明天要用车，我就坐渡轮进城吧，反正也挺方便的。
en: Seeing as you need the car tomorrow, I'll take the ferry into town — it's pretty handy anyway.
point: “反正”是 anyway，放句尾

zh: 我们原计划在山上住两晚，但预报说周日有大风，所以提前一天下山了。
en: We'd planned to camp up there for two nights, but the forecast was for gales on Sunday, so we came out a day early.
point: 徒步“下山”常说 came out；but + so 分两层

zh: 海滩上没有救生员，不过浪不大，所以孩子们还是下水玩了一会儿。
en: There weren't any lifeguards, but the surf was pretty calm, so the kids still had a quick swim.
point: “浪不大”是 surf was calm；“下水玩”是 had a swim

zh: 这边紫外线特别强，就算阴天也要涂防晒，在水上的时候更要注意。
en: The UV's really harsh here, so you need sunscreen even on cloudy days, especially if you're out on the water.
point: 中文不用“所以”，英文要补 so；“就算阴天”是 even on cloudy days

zh: 那场音乐会我们最后没去，倒不是票贵，主要是停车太麻烦了。
en: We ended up not going to the concert — it wasn't the price so much as the parking nightmare.
point: “倒不是A，主要是B”可说 not A so much as B

zh: 这周末本来想去看电影，可孩子们都吵着要去游泳，就随他们了。
en: We were going to see a movie this weekend, but the kids were desperate to go swimming, so we let them choose.
point: “吵着要”是 desperate to；“随他们”是 let them choose

zh: 我最近开始学陶艺，做出来的东西都歪歪扭扭的，但特别解压。
en: I've taken up pottery recently — everything I make comes out a bit wonky, but it's really good for stress.
point: “开始学”是 taken up；“歪歪扭扭”是 wonky

zh: 真不好意思，你们的婚礼我去不了，因为那周正好出差，礼物我会寄过去。
en: I'm so sorry I can't make your wedding, as I'm away on a work trip that week, but I'll post you a gift.
point: as 也可表原因，比 because 稍书面

zh: 今年圣诞我们不打算大办了，去年实在太累，就简单烧个烤吧。
en: We're keeping Christmas low-key this year because last year wore us out, so it'll just be a barbecue.
point: “不大办”是 keep it low-key；中文无连词，英文补 because 和 so

zh: 春节在这边不放假，不过我们还是请了一天假，带孩子去看舞狮。
en: Chinese New Year isn't a public holiday here, but we still took a day off to take the kids to see the lion dance.
point: “请一天假”是 took a day off；“还是”用 still

zh: 周末我们送孩子去上中文学校，因为不想让他们把中文忘了。
en: We send the kids to Chinese school on weekends because we don't want them to lose their Chinese.
point: “忘了中文”是 lose their Chinese

zh: 公公婆婆很想帮忙带孩子，可他们年纪大了，所以小的我们还是送去了托儿所。
en: My in-laws are keen to help with the kids, but they're getting on a bit, so we've put the little one in daycare.
point: “年纪大了”委婉说 getting on a bit

zh: 既然学校要家长轮流帮忙，那我就选周三吧，那天我正好在家办公。
en: Since the school wants parents to help out on a roster, I'll take Wednesdays, seeing as I work from home then.
point: since 和 seeing as 都表原因，可以在一句里分开用

zh: 我们下周出国，想找人上门照顾猫，因为送去寄养它会特别紧张。
en: We're going overseas next week, and we're after a pet sitter to come to the house, because the cattery really stresses her out.
point: “想找”NZ 说 we're after；“紧张”是 stresses her out

zh: 兽医说狗一直挠是因为跳蚤，开了药，可用了一个星期也没什么效果。
en: The vet said the scratching was down to fleas and gave us some treatment, but it hasn't made much difference after a week.
point: “没什么效果”是 hasn't made much difference；转折用 but

zh: 猫最近老吐，我们本来以为是毛球，可兽医说可能是肾出了问题。
en: The cat's been throwing up a lot lately; we thought it was just hairballs, but the vet reckons it could be her kidneys.
point: “本来以为”是 we thought；“吐”口语说 throwing up

zh: 那天我说话可能有点冲，主要是压力太大了，不是针对你。
en: I might've been a bit short with you the other day, mainly because I was under a lot of pressure — it wasn't personal.
point: “说话冲”是 short with；“不是针对你”是 it wasn't personal

zh: 我们虽然分手了，但还是朋友，所以在聚会上碰到他也不会尴尬。
en: We've broken up, but we're still friends, so it won't be awkward if he's at the party.
point: “尴尬”是 awkward；but + so 两层关系

zh: 我理解你为什么生气，可当时那种情况我也没别的办法。
en: I get why you're upset, but there wasn't really anything else I could do at the time.
point: “理解你为什么”是 I get why；“没别的办法”是 nothing else I could do

zh: 由于供应商延迟交货，项目第二阶段将推迟到下月中旬，给您带来的不便，我们深表歉意。
en: Due to a delay from our supplier, phase two of the project will be pushed back to mid-next month; we apologise for any inconvenience.
point: 正式通知用 due to + 名词；“深表歉意”是 apologise for any inconvenience

zh: 尽管本季度销售额略有下降，客户满意度却创下了历史新高。
en: Although sales dipped slightly this quarter, customer satisfaction has reached the highest level we've ever recorded.
point: 正式转折用 although，句中的“却”不译，也不加 but

zh: 鉴于团队目前人手紧张，我建议把这个需求放到下一个迭代再做。
en: Given that the team is currently stretched, I'd recommend deferring this request to the next sprint.
point: “鉴于”用 given that；“人手紧张”是 stretched

zh: 由于系统升级，所有员工须在周一上午九点前重设密码。
en: As a result of the system upgrade, all staff will need to reset their passwords before 9 a.m. on Monday.
point: 正式通知里“由于”可用 as a result of

zh: 虽然这次故障没有造成数据丢失，我们仍将全面检查备份流程，以防再次发生。
en: Although no data was lost in the outage, we will be carrying out a full review of our backup procedures to prevent a recurrence.
point: although 引导让步，主句不用 but；“以防再次发生”是 to prevent a recurrence

zh: 我们建议迁移到新平台，主要是因为现有系统明年以后将不再有安全更新。
en: We are recommending this migration primarily because the current system will no longer receive security updates after next year.
point: 正式场合“主要因为”可用 primarily because

zh: 我想换工作，是因为现在的岗位已经没什么成长空间了，而贵公司这个职位正好能发挥我的长处。
en: I'm looking to move on because there's limited room for growth in my current role, whereas this position would really play to my strengths.
point: whereas 对比两种情况；“发挥长处”是 play to my strengths

zh: 考虑到我有十年的相关经验，我希望薪资能比你们给的数字再高一些。
en: Considering my ten years of relevant experience, I was hoping the salary could be a little higher than the figure you've offered.
point: 谈薪用 considering + 名词；I was hoping 更委婉

zh: 由于家庭原因，我很遗憾必须辞去现在的职位，最后工作日为本月二十八号。
en: Owing to family circumstances, I regret that I must resign from my position, with my last working day being the 28th of this month.
point: “由于”很正式时用 owing to；“家庭原因”是 family circumstances

zh: 因为上周生病缺了课，能否麻烦您把课件发给我？医生证明已附上。
en: As I was unwell and missed last week's lectures, would you be able to send me the slides? I've attached a medical certificate.
point: 邮件开头用 As 交代原因，比 Because 更得体

zh: 虽然我的成绩略低于入学要求，但我相信我的工作经验足以弥补这一点。
en: Although my grades are slightly below the entry requirements, I believe my work experience more than makes up for this.
point: “弥补”是 make up for；although 后不再加 but

zh: 鉴于我在国内已经修过同类课程，我想申请这门课的学分减免。
en: In light of the equivalent course I completed overseas, I'd like to apply for credit for this paper.
point: “鉴于”也可用 in light of；“学分减免”是 apply for credit

zh: 我们这条街的回收垃圾已经连续三周没人收了，现在桶都满出来了，希望尽快处理。
en: As our street's recycling hasn't been collected for three weeks running, the bins are now overflowing, and I'd appreciate this being dealt with promptly.
point: “连续三周”是 three weeks running；正式请求用 I'd appreciate

zh: 尽管我们每年都按时续保，这次厨房漏水的理赔却被拒了，希望能重新审核。
en: Despite renewing our policy on time every year, our claim for the kitchen leak has been declined, and we'd like it reviewed.
point: despite + -ing，不能接完整句子；“拒赔”是 declined

zh: 我们对您的服务一直很满意，不过由于预算紧张，想把清洁改成两周一次。
en: We've been very happy with your service; however, due to budget constraints, we'd like to reduce the cleaning to once a fortnight.
point: however 前用分号；“两周一次”是 once a fortnight

zh: 浴室的排风扇坏了一个多月了，墙上已经开始长霉，请您尽快安排维修。
en: As the bathroom extractor fan has been broken for over a month and mould is now appearing on the walls, could you please arrange a repair urgently?
point: “排风扇”是 extractor fan；As 引出原因后接正式请求

zh: 虽然租约还有三个月才到期，但因为工作调动，我们需要提前解约，也愿意协助找新租客。
en: Although our lease has three months left to run, a work relocation means we need to end it early; we're happy to help find replacement tenants.
point: “因为工作调动”可化成名词主语 a work relocation means

zh: 鉴于入住检查报告里已经记录了地毯上的污渍，我们认为不应因此扣押金。
en: Given that the stain on the carpet was noted in the ingoing inspection report, we don't believe any deduction from the bond is justified.
point: “鉴于”是 given that；“入住检查”是 ingoing inspection

zh: 由于两家之间的篱笆已经很旧了，我们想跟您商量一起出钱换新的。
en: As the boundary fence between our properties is in poor condition, we'd like to discuss sharing the cost of replacing it.
point: “很旧”可说 in poor condition；“一起出钱”是 sharing the cost

zh: 尽管我们已多次跟邻居沟通，深夜噪音仍未改善，因此不得不向市政正式投诉。
en: Despite several conversations with our neighbours, the late-night noise has not improved, so we have no choice but to lodge a formal complaint with the council.
point: despite + 名词；“不得不”是 have no choice but to

zh: 由于报名人数不足，原定本周六的社区清洁活动将改期，新日期另行通知。
en: Due to low numbers, this Saturday's community clean-up has been postponed, and a new date will be confirmed shortly.
point: “报名人数不足”是 low numbers；“另行通知”是 confirmed shortly

zh: 虽然你们承诺上周就能修好，但我家到现在还是上不了网，严重影响了我在家办公。
en: Although you assured me it would be fixed last week, we still have no internet connection, which is seriously affecting my ability to work from home.
point: “承诺”是 assured me；which 引出后果，不用 but

zh: 账单上的读数和电表实际读数明显对不上，所以我们希望付款前能重新核对。
en: Since the reading on the bill clearly doesn't match the meter, we'd like it to be rechecked before we make payment.
point: “对不上”是 doesn't match；正式要求用 we'd like it to be

zh: 因为我目前暂时没有工作，无法一次付清欠款，能否安排分期付款？
en: As I'm currently between jobs, I'm unable to pay the balance in full; would it be possible to set up a payment plan?
point: “失业”委婉说 between jobs；“分期”是 payment plan

zh: 工程比合同约定晚了六周才完工，因此我们认为扣留部分尾款是合理的。
en: As the work was completed six weeks later than agreed in the contract, we feel it is reasonable to withhold part of the final payment.
point: “尾款”是 final payment；“扣留”是 withhold

zh: 这台冰箱虽然刚过一年保修期，但这个价位的电器，我认为理应用得更久。
en: Although the fridge is just outside its one-year warranty, I'd expect an appliance of this price to last considerably longer.
point: “过了保修期”是 outside its warranty；although 不配 but

zh: 鉴于你们的报价包含了垃圾清运，而另外两家没有，我们决定请你们来做。
en: Given that your quote includes rubbish removal and the other two don't, we've decided to go ahead with you.
point: given that 给出理由；“决定请你们做”是 go ahead with you

zh: 我上周订的床垫送到时包装破了，表面还有明显污渍，因此我要求全额退款，而不是换货。
en: The mattress I ordered last week arrived with damaged packaging and a visible stain, so I'm requesting a full refund rather than a replacement.
point: “要求”正式说 I'm requesting；“而不是换货”是 rather than a replacement

zh: 尽管你们网站上写着三到五天送达，我的订单两周了还没发货。
en: Despite your website stating delivery within three to five days, my order still hasn't been dispatched after two weeks.
point: despite + 名词 + -ing；“发货”是 dispatched

zh: 由于这个型号已经证实有质量问题，我希望能换成同价位的其他型号。
en: As this model has proven to be faulty, I'd like to exchange it for a different one in the same price range.
point: “有质量问题”是 faulty；“同价位”是 same price range

zh: 我们周六晚上明明提前订了位，到了却说没有记录，等了四十分钟，非常失望。
en: Although we'd booked in advance for Saturday evening, we were told there was no record of it and had to wait forty minutes, which was very disappointing.
point: although + 过去完成；用 which 带出评价，不用 but

zh: 由于我们公司聚餐的人数增加到了三十人，想确认一下能否包场。
en: As numbers for our work function have grown to thirty, I'd like to check whether we could book out the whole restaurant.
point: “包场”是 book out the whole restaurant；“聚餐”是 work function

zh: 因为有一位客人对麸质严重过敏，请务必确保厨房避免交叉污染。
en: As one of our guests has a severe gluten allergy, could you please make sure the kitchen takes care to avoid cross-contamination?
point: “麸质”是 gluten；“务必”用 please make sure

zh: 由于我的卡在海外被盗刷，我要求冻结账户，并退还这几笔未经授权的交易。
en: As my card has been used fraudulently overseas, I'd like the account frozen and these unauthorised transactions refunded.
point: “盗刷”是 used fraudulently；“未经授权”是 unauthorised

zh: 虽然我们的固定利率还有两年才到期，但鉴于别的银行利率更低，希望你们能重新报个价。
en: Although our fixed term doesn't end for two years, given that other banks are offering lower rates, we'd like you to reconsider your offer.
point: although 和 given that 可叠用，但不要再加 but

zh: 我今年的退税比预计少很多，后来才发现，是因为去年有份兼职收入没申报。
en: My tax refund was much lower than expected this year, and it turned out to be because I hadn't declared income from a part-time job.
point: “后来才发现是因为”是 it turned out to be because；“申报”是 declare

zh: 我家门口的路灯坏了一个多月，晚上很不安全，请尽快派人维修。
en: As the streetlight outside our house has been out for over a month, it's quite unsafe at night, and I'd ask that it be repaired promptly.
point: 路灯“坏了”是 out；正式请求用 I'd ask that

zh: 虽然我的工作签证还有三个月才到期，但我想提前了解续签需要准备哪些材料。
en: Although my work visa doesn't expire for another three months, I'd like to find out in advance what documents I'll need to renew it.
point: “提前了解”是 find out in advance；although 后不加 but

zh: 因为我的护照还在移民局审理，无法在截止日期前提供原件，能否先交一份认证复印件？
en: As my passport is currently with Immigration for processing, I'm unable to provide the original by the deadline; could I submit a certified copy instead?
point: “在审理中”是 with … for processing；“认证复印件”是 certified copy

zh: 由于手术要排队六个月左右，我想了解一下如果自费去私立医院需要多少钱。
en: Since the waiting list for surgery is around six months, I'd like to find out how much it would cost to go private.
point: “自费去私立”是 go private；since 引出已知原因

zh: 尽管我提前十分钟就到了，却等了一个多小时才见到医生，而且没人告诉我会延误。
en: Despite arriving ten minutes early, I waited over an hour to see the doctor, and nobody let me know about the delay.
point: despite + -ing；“却”不译；“告诉”是 let me know

zh: 我理解因为这属于既往病症，保险可能不赔，但希望能给一份书面说明。
en: I understand the claim may not be covered as it relates to a pre-existing condition, but I'd appreciate a written explanation.
point: “既往病症”是 pre-existing condition；as 放句中表原因

zh: 由于失窃时家里的报警系统正在维修，我们希望这不会影响理赔。
en: As our alarm system was being repaired when the burglary happened, we hope this won't affect our claim.
point: as 引出原因；“正在维修”是 was being repaired

zh: 虽然地震后房子外观看着没事，但有几扇门已经关不严了，建议请专业人员来评估。
en: Although the house looks fine from the outside after the quake, several doors no longer close properly, so we'd recommend a professional assessment.
point: “关不严”是 no longer close properly；although 后用 so 接结论

zh: 因为我落在火车上的笔记本电脑里有客户资料，所以必须正式报案。
en: Because the laptop I left on the train contains client data, I'm required to make a formal police report.
point: “报案”是 make a police report；“丢在”说 left on the train

zh: 我对这张停车罚单提出申诉，因为当时标志被树枝完全挡住了。
en: I'm writing to dispute this parking ticket, as the sign was completely hidden by overhanging branches at the time.
point: “申诉”是 dispute；as 表理由，比 because 正式

zh: 尽管这次事故责任在对方，我的保险公司还是要我先付自付额。
en: Even though the other driver was at fault, my insurer is still asking me to pay the excess upfront.
point: “责任在对方”是 at fault；“自付额”是 excess

zh: 鉴于这辆车下个月就要做 WOF，轮胎也得换，我觉得价格还可以再低一些。
en: Given that it's due for a WOF next month and needs new tyres, I think there's room to come down on the price.
point: “还可以再低”是 room to come down on the price

zh: 由于贵公司航班取消，我们错过了转机，多付了一晚的住宿费，希望能得到补偿。
en: Because your flight was cancelled, we missed our connection and incurred an extra night's accommodation, which we'd like to be reimbursed for.
point: “产生费用”是 incurred；“补偿”是 reimbursed

zh: 我们订的明明是海景房，入住时却被安排到了对着停车场的房间。
en: Although we had booked a sea-view room, we were given one overlooking the car park on arrival.
point: “对着”是 overlooking；although 的主句不用 but，也不译“却”

zh: 由于行李晚到了四天，我不得不买些基本衣物和洗漱用品，所有收据都附在后面。
en: As my luggage was delayed by four days, I had to buy essential clothing and toiletries, and I've attached all the receipts.
point: “洗漱用品”是 toiletries；as 引出原因

zh: 由于天气预报周末有恶劣天气，我们不得不取消小屋预订，请问可以退款吗？
en: Due to the severe weather forecast for the weekend, we've had to cancel our hut booking — would a refund be possible?
point: due to + 名词短语；“小屋”是 hut

zh: 虽然公园里的游乐设施去年才翻新，现在已经有好几处损坏，存在安全隐患。
en: Although the playground equipment was only upgraded last year, several parts are already damaged and pose a safety risk.
point: “存在安全隐患”是 pose a safety risk

zh: 我们理解出于安全考虑取消了观鲸，但事先没有任何通知，让我们白跑了一趟。
en: While we understand the whale-watching trip was cancelled for safety reasons, we received no prior notice and made the journey for nothing.
point: while 表“虽然理解”；“白跑一趟”是 made the journey for nothing

zh: 由于我膝盖受伤，医生建议半年内避免剧烈运动，因此我想暂停会员资格。
en: As I've injured my knee and been advised to avoid strenuous exercise for six months, I'd like to put my membership on hold.
point: “暂停会员”是 put on hold；“剧烈运动”是 strenuous exercise

zh: 尽管俱乐部经费有限，我认为还是应该优先给青少年队添置新护具。
en: Despite our limited funds, I believe we should still prioritise new protective gear for the junior teams.
point: despite + 名词；“优先添置”是 prioritise

zh: 我们决定不再与那位教练续约，理由是他多次无故缺席训练。
en: We've decided not to renew the coach's contract on the grounds that he repeatedly missed training without notice.
point: 正式说明理由用 on the grounds that

zh: 由于演出临时改期，新日期我去不了，所以想申请全额退款。
en: Since the show has been rescheduled to a date I can't attend, I'd like to request a full refund.
point: “改期”是 rescheduled；since 表已知原因

zh: 尽管我按时还了书，系统还是显示逾期，并收了我罚款。
en: Even though I returned the books on time, the system still shows them as overdue and I've been charged a fine.
point: “显示逾期”是 shows them as overdue；“罚款”是 charged a fine

zh: 我明确说了只剪两厘米，结果被剪掉了将近十厘米，希望能退部分费用。
en: Although I clearly asked for just two centimetres off, nearly ten were cut, so I'd like a partial refund.
point: “剪两厘米”是 two centimetres off；although 后不再说 but

zh: 非常感谢您的邀请，遗憾的是当天我已有安排，无法出席。
en: Thank you very much for the invitation; unfortunately, owing to a prior commitment, I'm unable to attend.
point: “已有安排”是 a prior commitment；正式婉拒用 unfortunately

zh: 虽然我来新西兰只有五年，这个俱乐部已经让我有了家的感觉。
en: Although I've only been in New Zealand for five years, this club has truly made me feel at home.
point: “有家的感觉”是 feel at home；演讲中 although 不接 but

zh: 鉴于上次聚会反响很好，我们提议以后每个季度办一次。
en: In view of the positive response to our last get-together, we're proposing to hold one every quarter from now on.
point: “鉴于”也可用 in view of；“反响好”是 positive response

zh: 惊悉令尊仙逝，我们深感悲痛，因身在国外无法出席葬礼，谨致以诚挚的慰问。
en: We were deeply saddened to hear of your father's passing, and as we're overseas and unable to attend the funeral, we send our heartfelt condolences.
point: as 引出的原因从句可嵌在句中；“慰问”是 condolences

zh: 由于孩子要跟我们回国过春节，下周将请假三天，我们会确保她补上落下的功课。
en: As we'll be travelling to China for Chinese New Year, our daughter will be absent for three days next week; we'll make sure she catches up.
point: 请假通知用 will be absent；“补功课”是 catch up

zh: 考虑到我们选的是工作日而不是周末，希望场地费能有些优惠。
en: Considering we've chosen a weekday rather than a weekend, we were hoping for some flexibility on the venue hire fee.
point: “有些优惠”委婉说 some flexibility on

zh: 由于我儿子最近在学校多次被同学欺负，我们希望能跟老师当面谈一次。
en: As our son has been bullied at school on several occasions recently, we'd like to arrange a meeting with his teacher.
point: “被欺负”是 bullied；“当面谈”是 arrange a meeting

zh: 虽然你们规定孩子发烧后要在家休息二十四小时，但她从昨晚起体温就正常了，今天能回园吗？
en: Although your policy is that children stay home for 24 hours after a fever, her temperature's been normal since last night — could she come back today?
point: although 先承认规定，再直接提出请求，不加 but

zh: 我们为父母申请探亲签证，主要是因为我们刚有了宝宝，非常需要他们的帮助。
en: We're applying for visitor visas for my parents, primarily because we've just had a baby and would really value their support.
point: “需要他们帮忙”正式说 would value their support

zh: 我们想申请在家养一只室内猫，鉴于它已绝育且习惯很好，应该不会对房子造成损坏。
en: We'd like to request permission to keep a small indoor cat; given that she's desexed and fully house-trained, we don't anticipate any damage.
point: “绝育”是 desexed；given that 引出理由

zh: 由于账单上列了几项我们并没有同意的检查，我们希望你们能解释一下这些费用。
en: Since the invoice includes tests we didn't consent to, we'd like an explanation of the charges.
point: “同意”是 consent to；正式“要求解释”用 we'd like an explanation

zh: 我们的狗今年不幸去世了，因此请注销它的登记，如有剩余费用请退还。
en: Our dog sadly passed away this year, so we'd like to cancel his registration and request a refund if one applies.
point: 宠物“去世”也可说 passed away；“如适用”是 if one applies

zh: 对于昨天会上我的不当言论，我深表歉意，那是一时冲动，并不代表我的真实想法。
en: I sincerely apologise for my comments in yesterday's meeting; they were said in the heat of the moment and don't reflect how I really feel.
point: “一时冲动”是 in the heat of the moment；“代表”是 reflect

zh: 尽管我多次向经理反映工作量过大，情况始终没有改善，所以我想正式提出这个问题。
en: Despite raising my workload with my manager several times, nothing has changed, so I'd like to raise it formally.
point: despite raising 之后不能再接 but；“反映”是 raise

zh: 她总是在别人最困难的时候伸出援手，所以我毫不犹豫地推荐她。
en: Because she has always been there for people when they needed it most, I recommend her without hesitation.
point: “伸出援手”可说 be there for；“毫不犹豫”是 without hesitation

zh: 说实话，这个截止日期有点紧，倒不是我们不想做，只是手上还有两个项目在赶。
en: To be honest, the deadline's a bit tight — not that we're not keen, it's just that we've got two other projects on the go.
point: “倒不是…只是”用 not that …, it's just that；“在赶”是 on the go

zh: 我明白你的意思，不过去年我们试过类似的做法，最后也没搞出什么名堂，所以我有点犹豫。
en: I take your point, but we tried something similar last year and it didn't really go anywhere, so I'm a bit hesitant.
point: “明白你的意思”是 I take your point；“没搞出名堂”是 didn't go anywhere

zh: 我是很想帮忙，可这周真忙得焦头烂额，下周再看看行吗？
en: Much as I'd love to help out, I'm absolutely snowed under this week — could we have another look next week?
point: much as 表“虽然很想”；“忙得焦头烂额”是 snowed under

zh: 这个 bug 其实也不能全怪测试组，毕竟需求改了三次，谁也跟不上。
en: To be fair, you can't really blame testing for that bug — the requirements changed three times, after all, so nobody could keep up.
point: “毕竟”是 after all；“说句公道话”是 to be fair

zh: 新系统确实花了不少钱，话说回来，至少现在不用半夜爬起来打补丁了。
en: The new system did cost a fair bit; then again, at least nobody's getting up in the middle of the night to patch it any more.
point: “话说回来”是 then again；用 did 强调“确实”

zh: 我不是说你的方案不好，只是担心用户一下子适应不了这么大的变化。
en: I'm not saying your design's bad; I'm just a bit worried users might struggle with such a big change all at once.
point: “不是说…只是”是 I'm not saying …, I'm just

zh: 这份工作各方面都挺好，就是通勤要命，所以我还在纠结要不要接。
en: The job ticks pretty much every box, but the commute's a killer, so I'm still in two minds about taking it.
point: “各方面都好”是 ticks every box；“纠结”是 in two minds

zh: 他们没明说为什么没要我，不过我估计是我的期望薪资报高了。
en: They didn't spell out why I didn't get it, but I suspect it's because I pitched my salary expectations a bit high.
point: “明说”是 spell out；“估计是因为”用 I suspect it's because 更委婉

zh: 广告上写着“薪资有竞争力”，可面试下来，我感觉他们其实给不了多少。
en: The ad said 'competitive salary', but from the interview I got the feeling there wasn't much wiggle room on pay.
point: “给不了多少”委婉说 not much wiggle room

zh: 这次考得不算好，不过考虑到我同时还在全职上班，也算尽力了。
en: I didn't exactly ace the exam, but considering I was working full-time as well, I reckon I did all right.
point: “考得不算好”可说 didn't exactly ace；“也算不错”是 did all right

zh: 我倒也不是讨厌小组作业，就是每次好像都是我一个人干了大部分。
en: It's not that I mind group projects as such — it's more that I always seem to end up doing the lion's share.
point: “大部分”是 the lion's share；as such 弱化语气

zh: 既然学费都交了，现在半途而废多可惜，再坚持一个学期吧。
en: Seeing as you've already paid the fees, it'd be a shame to throw in the towel now — why not stick it out for one more semester?
point: “半途而废”是 throw in the towel；“坚持下去”是 stick it out

zh: 说句公道话，他做家务倒是挺积极的，就是白衣服每次都被他洗成粉的。
en: He does pitch in with the housework, to be fair — it's just that somehow my whites always end up pink.
point: “倒是”可用 to be fair；does 强调“确实做”

zh: 又是装修又是孩子放假，家里乱成一锅粥，这次就不请你们来吃饭了。
en: What with the renovations and the kids being on holiday, the house is in chaos, so we'll have to give dinner a miss this time.
point: “又是…又是”表原因可用 what with … and …

zh: 那张沙发我承认是好看，可咱家这么小，买回来连转身的地方都没了。
en: It's a gorgeous couch, I'll admit, but in a place this size we'd barely have room to swing a cat.
point: I'll admit 先让步再转折；“地方小”的习语是 no room to swing a cat

zh: 房东说下周就来修，不过他上次也是这么说的，所以我不抱太大希望。
en: The landlord says he'll sort it next week, but he said that last time too, so I'm not holding my breath.
point: “不抱希望”是 not holding my breath

zh: 我们也不是不想续租，只是房租一下涨了这么多，实在有点吃不消。
en: It's not like we don't want to stay — it's just that the rent's gone up so much we're really feeling the pinch.
point: “吃不消”指经济压力时说 feeling the pinch；it's not like 很口语

zh: 这个室友人还行，就是好像觉得厨房不归他管，所以我打算委婉地提一下。
en: He's a decent enough flatmate, but he seems to think the kitchen's somebody else's problem, so I'm going to tactfully bring it up.
point: “委婉地提一下”是 tactfully bring it up

zh: 我不想小题大做，可他们家的树都长到我们屋顶上了，总得有人说一声。
en: I don't want to make a big deal of it, but their tree's growing over our roof now, so someone's going to have to say something.
point: “小题大做”是 make a big deal of it

zh: 新搬来的邻居看着有点高冷，不过人家刚来，可能只是还没适应吧。
en: The new neighbours seem a bit standoffish, but to be fair they've only just moved in, so maybe they're just finding their feet.
point: “高冷”是 standoffish；“还没适应”是 finding their feet

zh: 他们偶尔开个派对我们倒无所谓，受不了的是每个周末都闹到凌晨三点。
en: We don't mind the odd party, honestly — it's the three a.m. finishes every single weekend that are wearing a bit thin.
point: 用强调句 it's … that 点出真正原因；“让人受不了”是 wearing thin

zh: 这么说吧，这已经是我第四次打电话了，每次都说马上解决，所以这次我想直接跟主管谈。
en: Look, this is my fourth call about this, and each time I've been told it'll be sorted, so this time I'd like to speak to a supervisor.
point: “这么说吧”可用 Look 开头；先摆事实再用 so 提要求

zh: 他们的套餐看着便宜，可算上各种隐藏费用，其实一点都不划算。
en: Their plan looks cheap on paper, but once you factor in all the hidden fees, it's actually not that great a deal.
point: “看着便宜”是 cheap on paper；“算上”是 factor in

zh: 停电本来就够烦了，偏偏还赶上我刚把冰箱塞满了海鲜。
en: A power cut's annoying enough at the best of times, but it had to happen the day I'd stocked the fridge with seafood.
point: “本来就够烦了，偏偏…”可用 annoying enough at the best of times

zh: 他活儿干得是不错，不过最后的账单比报价高出不少，我想问问是怎么回事。
en: He did a decent job, don't get me wrong, but the final bill was quite a bit more than the quote, so I'd like to know why.
point: don't get me wrong 用来软化后面的转折

zh: 我知道我老公觉得自己能修，可上回他“修”完洗衣机，我们最后还是买了台新的。
en: I know my husband reckons he can fix it, but the last time he 'fixed' the washing machine, we ended up buying a new one anyway.
point: 引号表示反讽；“最后还是”是 ended up … anyway

zh: 反正电工都要来了，不如顺便把那几个插座也换了，省得他再跑一趟。
en: Seeing as the electrician's coming anyway, we might as well get those sockets done while he's here and save him a second trip.
point: “顺便”是 while he's here；“省得再跑”是 save … a trip

zh: 打完折是挺便宜的，不过说实话，我买回来大概也就穿一次。
en: It's a bargain at that price, sure, but if I'm honest, I'd probably only wear it once.
point: sure, but 先让步再转折；“说实话”是 if I'm honest

zh: 我不是那种爱退货的人，可这双鞋穿了一个星期就开胶了，实在说不过去。
en: I'm not normally one to take things back, but these shoes started coming apart after a week, which just isn't on.
point: “说不过去”可说 isn't on；“不是那种人”是 not one to

zh: 网上评价倒是挺高，不过我总怀疑一半是刷的，还是去店里看看实物再说。
en: The online reviews are glowing, but I've got a sneaking suspicion half of them are fake, so I'd rather see it in the shop first.
point: “总怀疑”是 a sneaking suspicion；“倒是”的让步用 but 转回来

zh: 菜还行吧，不过就这个价钱，我本来期待会更好一点。
en: The food was fine, but for what we paid I'd have expected a bit more, to be honest.
point: “就这个价钱”是 for what we paid；I'd have expected 委婉表达失望

zh: 倒不是服务员态度不好，就是忙得根本顾不上我们，半天都没人来点单。
en: It's not that the staff were rude — they were just run off their feet, so nobody came to take our order for ages.
point: “忙得顾不上”是 run off their feet

zh: 这家店看着不起眼，你可别被骗了，他们的饺子是全城最好吃的。
en: It doesn't look like much from the outside, but don't let that fool you — their dumplings are the best in town.
point: “不起眼”是 doesn't look like much；“别被骗”用 don't let that fool you

zh: 我们倒也不是缺钱，只是花三千块买个咖啡机，总觉得有点说不过去。
en: It's not as if we're short of money; it just seems a bit hard to justify three grand on a coffee machine.
point: “倒也不是”可用 it's not as if；“说不过去”是 hard to justify

zh: 那个投资回报好得不像真的，这种一般都是骗局，我劝你还是别碰。
en: The returns sound too good to be true, and in my experience that usually means it's a scam, so I'd steer well clear.
point: “好得不像真的”是 too good to be true；“别碰”是 steer clear

zh: AA 制当然公平，可他每次都点最贵的，然后说平摊，这就有点那个了。
en: Splitting the bill is fair enough, but when he orders the most expensive thing and then suggests going halves, it's a bit rich.
point: “有点那个”含蓄批评可说 a bit rich

zh: 表格本身倒不难，难的是要找齐那些十年前的文件。
en: The form itself isn't the hard part; it's tracking down documents from ten years ago that's the real headache.
point: “A不难，难的是B”用强调句 it's B that's …

zh: 按理说两周就能出结果，可现在都一个多月了，我也不好意思老打电话催。
en: In theory it should only take two weeks, but it's been over a month now, and I don't want to keep pestering them.
point: “按理说”是 in theory；“催”是 pester / chase up

zh: 他们说材料不全，可我明明全都交了，我怀疑是他们自己弄丢了。
en: They say my application's incomplete, but I definitely sent everything, so I can't help thinking they've lost something at their end.
point: “明明”用 definitely；“怀疑”委婉说 I can't help thinking

zh: 医生说没什么大事，不过既然一直不好，我还是想转专科看看，图个安心。
en: The GP says it's nothing serious, but seeing as it's not clearing up, I'd still like a referral, just for peace of mind.
point: “图个安心”是 for peace of mind；“转诊”是 referral

zh: 我也知道该少喝点咖啡，可不喝的话，我一上午都跟废了一样。
en: I know I should cut down on coffee, but without it I'm basically useless until lunchtime.
point: “少喝”是 cut down on；用 without it 代替 if 条件句

zh: 倒不是说这个药没用，只是副作用让我整天昏昏沉沉的，所以想问问有没有别的选择。
en: It's not that the medication isn't working — it's more that it leaves me feeling groggy all day, so I wondered if there were alternatives.
point: “昏昏沉沉”是 groggy；I wondered if 委婉提问

zh: 谢天谢地没人受伤，不过车估计是报废了，修的钱比车还值钱。
en: Thankfully nobody was hurt, but the car's probably a write-off — it'd cost more to fix than it's worth.
point: “报废”是 a write-off；“修比买贵”是 cost more to fix than it's worth

zh: 我知道打 111 可能有点过了，可当时那人倒在路边一动不动，我不敢冒这个险。
en: I know calling 111 might seem like overkill, but he was lying on the side of the road not moving, and I wasn't going to take any chances.
point: “有点过了”是 overkill；“不敢冒险”是 wasn't going to take any chances

zh: 大家都说这边地震很常见，话虽如此，第一次遇上还是吓得不轻。
en: Everyone says earthquakes are pretty common here; even so, my first one gave me a real fright.
point: “话虽如此”是 even so；“吓得不轻”是 a real fright

zh: 我不是说你车开得不好，可这几个弯你是不是开得有点快了？
en: I'm not having a go at your driving, but don't you think you're taking these corners a bit fast?
point: “不是说你”可用 I'm not having a go at；用否定疑问委婉提醒

zh: 车是旧了点，毛病也不少，可它从没把我扔在半路上，所以我舍不得卖。
en: It's old and it's got its quirks, but it's never once left me stranded, so I can't bring myself to sell it.
point: “舍不得”是 can't bring myself to；“扔在半路”是 left me stranded

zh: 坐公交是省钱，可每天多花四十分钟，算下来也不见得划算。
en: The bus does save money, but once you count the extra forty minutes a day, I'm not sure it really pays off.
point: “不见得”委婉说 I'm not sure it really；“划算”是 pays off

zh: 那家酒店照片上看着很美，实际上嘛，就说它很有“特色”吧。
en: The hotel looked stunning in the photos; in reality, let's just say it had plenty of 'character'.
point: let's just say 加引号，带幽默的委婉批评

zh: 机票是便宜，可转两次机，中间还要等九个小时，这钱省得有点不值。
en: The flights were cheap, admittedly, but with two stopovers and a nine-hour layover, I'm not sure the savings were worth it.
point: “是便宜”用 admittedly 让步；“转机等待”是 layover

zh: 既然大老远飞过来了，不多待几天也太可惜了。
en: Having flown all this way, you'd be mad not to stay on for a few more days.
point: “既然都…”可用 having + 过去分词；“太可惜”口语说 you'd be mad not to

zh: 那条步道标的是“中等难度”，可对我这种平时不运动的人来说，简直要命。
en: The track's rated 'moderate', but for someone as unfit as me, it was an absolute killer.
point: “要命”是 an absolute killer；for someone as … as me 表对比

zh: 预报说是晴天，可这是新西兰啊，包里还是塞件雨衣比较保险。
en: The forecast says sunny, but this is New Zealand, so you'd be wise to throw a raincoat in your pack just in case.
point: “这是新西兰啊”暗含原因，用 so 接建议

zh: 露营好玩是好玩，可那些沙蝇真是让人抓狂。
en: Camping's great fun and all, but the sandflies are something else — they drove me up the wall.
point: and all 弱化前半句；“让人抓狂”是 drove me up the wall

zh: 我们队这赛季输多赢少，话虽这么说，大家玩得还挺开心，这才是最重要的。
en: We've lost more than we've won this season; that said, everyone's having a good time, which is what really matters.
point: “话虽这么说”是 that said；“这才是最重要的”是 which is what really matters

zh: 他跑马拉松与其说是为了成绩，不如说是为了给癌症研究筹款。
en: He's not running the marathon for a personal best so much as to raise money for cancer research.
point: “与其说…不如说”是 not … so much as

zh: 我不是要贬低全黑队，可这场赢得确实有点运气成分。
en: Not to take anything away from the All Blacks, but there was a fair bit of luck involved in that win.
point: “不是要贬低”是 not to take anything away from

zh: 那部电影大家都说好，可能是我期望太高了，看完觉得也就那样。
en: Everyone raved about the film, but maybe my expectations were too high, because I thought it was just OK.
point: “大家都说好”是 raved about；“也就那样”是 just OK

zh: 理论上我是挺想参加读书会的，可实际上一个月读一本书，我现在真做不到。
en: I'd love to join the book club in theory, but realistically a book a month is more than I can manage right now.
point: “理论上…实际上”用 in theory … but realistically

zh: 理发师一口咬定这个发型显年轻，虽然我自己照镜子时不太确定。
en: The hairdresser swears this cut makes me look younger, though I'm not so sure when I look in the mirror.
point: though 放后半句表保留意见；“一口咬定”是 swears

zh: 他每次都说“下次一定来”，不过咱俩私下说，我已经不太指望了。
en: He always says he'll come next time, but between you and me, I've stopped counting on it.
point: “私下说”是 between you and me；“不指望”是 stopped counting on it

zh: 他整晚都在聊他的加密货币，大家虽然早就听腻了，可看他那么兴奋，谁也不好意思打断。
en: He banged on about crypto all night, and although everyone was over it, he was so excited that nobody had the heart to stop him.
point: “听腻了”是 over it；“不好意思”是 didn't have the heart to

zh: 我倒是想多交点本地朋友，可他们一到周末好像都跑去海边或者看球了。
en: I'd love to make more Kiwi friends, but they all seem to disappear to the beach or the rugby at weekends.
point: “好像都”是 all seem to；“倒是想”用 I'd love to … but

zh: 礼物嘛，心意到了就行，真没必要花那么多钱。
en: Honestly, it's the thought that counts with presents, so there's really no need to splash out like that.
point: “心意到了就行”是 it's the thought that counts；“花大钱”是 splash out

zh: 说是简单吃个饭庆祝一下，结果来了五十多个人，我妈还是一贯的“低调”。
en: It was meant to be a quiet dinner to celebrate, but over fifty people turned up — Mum's idea of 'low-key', clearly.
point: 引号加 clearly 表反讽；“说是”是 meant to be

zh: 春节我们一般都回国，不过今年孩子要考试，只好在这边将就过了。
en: We usually head home for Chinese New Year, but with the kids' exams coming up, we'll have to make do here this year.
point: with + 名词短语表原因；“将就”是 make do

zh: 我婆婆特别爱给我们育儿建议，她是好心，可有时候真有点吃不消。
en: My mother-in-law loves giving us parenting advice, and her heart's in the right place, but it can get a bit much.
point: “是好心”还可说 her heart's in the right place；“吃不消”是 a bit much

zh: 儿子说不想学钢琴了，据他说不是因为难，而是因为“不够酷”。
en: My son wants to give up piano — not because it's too hard, apparently, but because it's not 'cool' enough.
point: apparently 表转述孩子的理由，带点幽默

zh: 既然爷爷奶奶来了，我们不如趁机溜出去过一晚，反正孩子们巴不得跟他们待着。
en: Now that the grandparents are here, we could sneak off for a night away — the kids would much rather hang out with them anyway.
point: “趁机溜出去”是 sneak off；“巴不得”是 would much rather

zh: 我们本来只是去“看看”小狗，结果你也猜到了，抱了一只回家。
en: We only went along to 'have a look' at the puppies, but you can guess how that ended — we came home with one.
point: “你也猜到了”是 you can guess how that ended；引号表自嘲

zh: 养狗是挺好的，不过它每天都得遛，风雨无阻，这一点你得先想清楚。
en: Having a dog's lovely, but bear in mind it needs walking every day, rain or shine, so think it through first.
point: “风雨无阻”是 rain or shine；“想清楚”是 think it through

zh: 邻居说我们家猫老去他们家偷吃猫粮，我也没办法，总不能把猫拴起来吧。
en: The neighbours say our cat keeps raiding their cat's food, but there's not much I can do — it's not like you can keep a cat on a lead.
point: “总不能…吧”用 it's not like，口语地给出理由

zh: 我不是生你的气，就是有点失望，因为我以为你至少会先跟我商量一下。
en: I'm not angry with you, just a bit disappointed, because I thought you'd at least run it by me first.
point: “商量一下”是 run it by me；“不是…就是”用 not …, just …

zh: 他一直说自己没事，可我看得出来他心里挺难受的。
en: He keeps insisting he's fine, but I can tell he's pretty cut up about it underneath.
point: “心里难受”是 cut up about it；“看得出来”是 I can tell

zh: 跟他吵也没用，他认定的事谁也劝不动，还不如先让他冷静冷静。
en: There's no point arguing with him — once he's made up his mind, nobody can talk him round, so we might as well let him cool off.
point: “劝不动”是 talk him round；“还不如”是 might as well
